name: Slack

steps.d: api.slack.com/apps → Create New App → From scratch, pick a dev workspace.
OAuth & Permissions → add redirect URL and only the bot scopes you use.
Manage Distribution → activate. Lets other workspaces install without a review.
Only needed to be listed. Review time varies.

blockers.s: Some scopes draw extra scrutiny in Marketplace review; request less up front.

agent: Pick minimum scopes for your use case
you: Create the app in your workspace
